name: spec-to-canvas
description: PRD or spec to a buildable design canvas drawn on the real app: capture, matrix, NEW / PARTIAL markers with where, callout notes, optional Before / After, optional reference-UI snapshot strip, states with Entry and Data, screen and feature IDs, a canvas-states.json manifest for the build. Skills: spec-to-canvas, spec-to-canvas-nohtml (single static HTML), spec-to-canvas-html (interactive canvas). Building is the canvas-to-app plugin. Keeps a memory of lessons that grows every run. Was named canvas-to-app up to 0.6.0.
